contract: CANONICAL (Sol interior visual-correction). Shell = four interior walls + ceiling ONLY, NO floor, no dollhouse roof / exterior facade, no open cutaway side, exactly one real doorway; entrance faces local -Z, +Y up, pivot at floor center. Floor = flat tile, top surface pivot y=0, thickness downward. If Meshy cannot reliably close a room from one image, generate the modularComponents via the same pipeline and assemble the closed shell in Blender (NO visible primitive geometry).
conceptTemplate: Interior architectural room shell only, photoreal reference render from a camera standing INSIDE a small fully ENCLOSED room looking into a corner so two or three solid interior walls meet a beamed ceiling above; a single plain plank doorway is the only opening; NO open/cutaway wall, NO dollhouse roof, NO exterior facade, NO visible floor boards emphasised, and no furniture, people, text, or watermark; plain soft even studio lighting. Historically accurate 1765 Boston construction: {DETAIL}. Aged working building, not a museum reconstruction; surfaces suitable for Meshy image-to-3D and Blender assembly.
